name: TabbyAPI
what: The OpenAI-compatible server for ExLlamaV3 (and V2): EXL3 and EXL2 quantized models that live entirely on the card, with a model folder it loads from and unloads to on request, an admin key for those calls and an API key for inference. A Python project run from a checkout; its start script keeps the dependencies current.

version.note: a git checkout without a version of its own; the update check compares commits

detect.note: one TabbyAPI server is one unit; its model_id is the folder name under model_dir that /v1/model/load takes. The server shares 5000 with textgen's API by default: give one of them another port.

auth.note: the admin key serves the api-key routes too; without it /v1/model answers 401 and the unit reads as unloaded

endpoints.current: GET /v1/model (a model card; 400 when none is loaded)
endpoints.load: POST /v1/model/load {model_name} (an SSE stream for the whole load)

can: start a unit from start.bat / start.sh
load a model from model_dir and unload it through the API, with the admin key read from api_tokens.yml
cannot: see busy: /v1/status lists recent jobs with finished ones, and the table has no shape for that yet; an unload while generating is TabbyAPI's own skip_wait
offload to RAM: ExLlama is all-GPU, so the model must fit the card
drive.note: Table from the source (endpoints/core/router.py, common/auth.py, 2026-11-07). Not yet driven from any machine.

never: the admin key anywhere but api_tokens.yml

update.note: The check tells you when main moved; start.bat --update-deps (start.sh on Linux) pulls and refreshes the wheels, then restart the unit.

windows: copy config_sample.yml to config.yml and api_tokens_sample.yml to api_tokens.yml; set model.model_dir
start.bat (makes the venv, installs ExLlamaV3 for your CUDA, starts on 5000)
then: Put an EXL3 (or EXL2) model folder under model_dir

good: dense models that fit the card entirely, at the quality EXL3 gets per bit
several EXL models taking turns on one card through load and unload
not: MoE with experts in RAM: it does not offload
GGUF files: convert, or use llama.cpp
